description: Surface maps of planets and moons for the Unity viewer (P6-07, visual assets only). Each map is reprojected by `usim-pipeline textures` to an equirectangular grid in planetocentric latitude and east longitude, the left edge at 180 degrees, and written as a JPEG with ATTRIBUTION.md. Not simulation data. Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Titan, Deimos and the Uranian moons have no map: no visible-light global mosaic from a verified source (Venus and Titan show only cloud or haze tops in visible light).

textures.name: Mercury
textures.content: Monochrome (750 nm) global mosaic of MESSENGER MDIS images, May 2013 basemap
textures.credit: Arizona State University, MESSENGER Team; USGS Astrogeology Science Center
